composition.normalizedFunctionComparison: function nextFindFunction(text,name){var ast=narrowParser.parse(text,{ecmaVersion:'latest',sourceType:'module'}),found=[];function visit(n){if(!n||typeof n!=='object')return;if(n.type==='FunctionDeclaration'&&n.id?.name===name)found.push(n);for(var[k,v]of Object.entries(n)){if(['start','end','raw'].includes(k))continue;if(Array.isArray(v))v.forEach(visit);else if(v&&typeof v==='object')visit(v);}}visit(ast);if(found.length!==1)throw Error('function count '+found.length);function clean(n){if(Array.isArray(n))return n.map(clean);if(n&&typeof n==='object')return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(n).filter(([k])=>!['start','end','raw'].includes(k)).map(([k,v])=>[k,clean(v)]));return n;}return clean(found[0]);}

forwarding.conclusion: Main supplies description and browsingContext at the actual attachJourneyChooser construction; journey-chooser forwards them explicitly, mission-library-chooser spreads them, and browser consumes them. Lazy journey facade forwards open to openUnifiedMissions and does not filter constructor options. Worlds onWorlds(opener, lifecycleOptions) is a distinct callback; game-shell navigationContext remains independent.

findings: All seven overlapping outputs reconstruct both exact input sides, have zero overlapping edit ranges and parse as modules.
Both complete unions hash identically whether applying PR paths to f465 or f465 paths to the PR head.

The joint generated mission-library-browser function AST equals the combined canonical function exactly after removing only source locations and literal raw spelling. Other 30 generated module slots preserve their correct owning-side bytes.
No semantic or textual conflict justifies a new branch head solely for this target. Preserve current passing #1620 head/gates; keep #1674 draft while its own current diagnostic/source checks run.
